correctness.rationale: Right-multiplication commutation criterion gives exact toggling of adjacent two-cycles and preservation of all long two-cycles; every long-matching sector is a product of matching-flip Fibonacci cubes. Distances, diameters, extremal components and total counts follow. Poisson(2) factorial moments and Poisson(1) short-cycle moments use standard exact telephone-number ratios. Exhaustive standalone BFS and neighbor checking pass n<=9, and all pairwise shortest-path checks pass n<=8. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.
